contentText: Despite a fragile ceasefire, Israeli strikes continue to hit parts of southern Lebanon. The latest attacks targeted areas near Nabatiyeh, a region that has come under repeated bombardment. While Israel says it is striking Hezbollah targets, civilians have continued to bear the consequences, with many forced to flee their homes. FRANCE 24's Antonia Kerrigan reports from the predominantly Christian city of Jezzine, where some of those displaced by the strikes have taken refuge.
